# AgentFlight CLI

> AgentFlight CLI (`agentflight-cli`) is an open-source Python AST auditing tool that monitors autonomous AI coding agents and prevents them from deleting or tampering with test assertions to artificially pass CI/CD pipelines.

- Website: https://agentflight-cli.vercel.app/
- PyPI Package: https://pypi.org/project/agentflight-cli/
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/Viperhawks/AgentFlight
- Latest Version: 1.0.1
- Author: Astel Antony (Viperhawks)
- License: MIT

## Quick Start

Install via pip:

```bash
pip install agentflight-cli
```

Run your test suite or wrap an AI agent command:

```bash
agentflight pytest
```

Or run with default pytest execution:

```bash
agentflight
```

## Core Capabilities

- **Test Auto-Discovery**: Automatically finds `**/test_*.py` and `**/*_test.py` files across the workspace while ignoring virtual environments (`venv`, `.venv`, `site-packages`) and hidden folders.
- **Python AST Assertion Baseline (`TestIntegrityAuditor`)**: Parses Python Abstract Syntax Trees (`ast.parse`) before and after command execution to extract `assert` statements (`ast.Assert`) and `with pytest.raises(...)` blocks (`ast.With`).
- **Git Tree State Tracking**: Captures `git write-tree` state hashes before and after running the agent or test command.
- **CI/CD Tamper Blocking**: Compares pre- and post-execution assertion sets (`old_asserts - new_asserts`). If any assertion is deleted, flags the file as `FLAGGED_SUSPICIOUS`, prints deleted assertions, and exits with status code `2` to block CI/CD pipelines.

- [Full LLM Documentation](https://agentflight-cli.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Detailed architecture, CLI reference, exit codes, and example output.
